title: YOUR FOV
IS GUESSING.
slides.sub: Measure it once. Brake at the same marker every lap.

title: HORIZONTAL FOV.
slides.label: W = VISIBLE SCREEN WIDTH · D = EYES TO SCREEN
slides.body: Measure both in the **same units**. The result is in degrees.

title: TWO NUMBERS.
slides.body: W: image width, not the bezel. D: **eyes to screen, seated**.

title: 4 STEPS.

steps.title: Check the game
steps.body: Horizontal, vertical or 3D FOV? Convert if needed

slides.body: Games label FOV differently: **check yours first.**

title: REAL SCALE.
REAL MARKERS.
slides.body: The screen acts like a window at true scale, so **speed and distance read the same every lap**. Easier to repeat your braking points.

title: MEASURE IT.
DON'T GUESS IT.
slides.body: A wide FOV feels fast. The right FOV makes you consistent.

caption:
Your FOV is guessing. 🎯
Two measurements, one formula, and your braking markers stop moving. Save this before you change your settings.
